subject: Getting number of rows for get

messages.author: fffa96c918e25526
messages.subject: Getting number of rows for get
parts:
Hi,

We are using hbase to scrape tweets and want to consume it in R with rHadoop package family.
Right now there are some challenges (lack of information) inhibiting us from exploiting these packages to the fullest.

I have some questions regarding our implementation/approach to this problem.
I would begin by describing our use-case.

We are using rHbase to interface with a hbase table containing tweet data.
My row key contains keyword:timestamp:tweet_ID:user:ID
Here keyword is 'some keyword' occurring in the text of tweet.

My question are-

1)- What would be the best way to retrieve all tweets for a given keyword lying between timestamp 'A' to timestamp 'B' (timestamp is a part of key).
   a. How can I know the number of rows returned by the above operation?  
   b. after getting the result I would like to sort the result set based on timestamp.
   c. I also need to remove any duplicate rows in the result (same tweet for different keyword).

Right now we are generating a regex to match all rows with given timestamp range and passing this regex as a filter to hb.scan. It returns an object with reference to the result set. But there is now way of knowing how many rows does my result set have.

2)- After getting the result set of the above query (preferably in hbase itself) we need a 'streaming interface' to get the result to R for processing.
   a- What would be the best approach to the 'streaming solution'?

p.s. I am just starting out with hadoop/hbase and have very limited knowledge of it. Please excuse any stupid remark above on my behalf. Please let me know in case of any clarifications.
